notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar Altar by sacrificing Inga, adding {C}{C}.
When Inga dies, it's second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Inga trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Inga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Inga enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to scry 3.
Repeat.
